name: Midou Yuuki
source:
A nurse working at a university hospital.
She is in charge of conveying various messages to the protagonist, who has the special job of "washing corpses."
In reality, she is a calm, kind-hearted woman who is well-liked by patients, but she comes across as cold towards the protagonist, as she treats him in an extremely businesslike and dispassionate manner.
Perhaps she is hiding something in her heart...

[Translated from the [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20080915215649/http://www.silkys.jp/game/shitai/chara/yuuki.html]official site[/url]]
